context.scope: 171 remaining rows from the bounded initial selected-map omission review, excluding the 40 plans handled earlier. This is not a full-day or exhaustive repository reconciliation.
context.deduplication: Exact original byte identities compared with all40plan records,349outcome records and source-index delta/already-published records. Identical remaining rows reference one payload. No source code or prior bundle copied.
context.content_hash_rule: Canonical UTF-8 JSON of individual metadata.json records: sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false, no trailing newline. File SHA256 values in MANIFEST are hashes of actual exported bytes.

stages.source_presence: All171 exact original SHA256 values verified. This says nothing about runtime wiring.
stages.configuration_and_wiring: Historical declared joins, configuration, source relationships and limits are retained as reported. No current installation or wiring is asserted.
stages.offline: Only recorded AST/hash/source-control or test outcomes are historical evidence; no new checks of product behavior ran in this assignment. Test phase report counts are not unique case counts.
stages.live: No live execution in this assignment. Historical isolated boundary observations are explicitly qualified in their records and do not imply browser journey acceptance.

context.nested_reference_policy: Nested artifact digests are copied as recorded assertions; only the171 original metadata files and deduplication index/payload bytes were verified here. A nested digest is not a fresh verification of that referenced runtime/source file.
context.privacy: Original files, binding-map contents, private source locators, host identities, credentials, TASK payloads and raw logs are not exported. The private audit maps each public row to its original locator.
context.unknown_policy: Unknown or missing timings/outcomes stay null or absent, never zero. Historical timestamps are not fabricated from mtimes. No aggregate elapsed time inferred from overlapping receipts.
